text:
Ethan R: Quick sign-off needed for ApolloCloud marketplace thumbnail + one-liner for the case study card. Partner uploaded badge zip here: https://files.redwood.com/apollo/badges.zip. Goal: publish Tuesday.
Priya S: Thanks. Two asks: 1) micro-tile CTA color must meet AA on light and dark backgrounds; 2) copy needs to fit 140 char limit for marketplace metadata.
Carmen (design): Downloaded assets. Observations: compact mark centers better than horizontal lockup at 140px. The horizontal crops at small sizes lose the tail of the A mark. Recommend compact mark centered with 8px clearspace. Exports needed:
- SVG (compact)
- PNG 140x140 (1x) and 280x280 (2x)
- PNG 72dpi hero preview (600x300)
Also CTA color suggestion to pass AA on dark bg: use #002e8c.
Alex Chen (Apollo): Confirming official byline: "Alex Chen, VP Cloud Infrastructure". You have permission to use the logo and short customer quote: "Cut inference costs by 3x in prod."
LegalBot: Received signed asset use agreement. Logo use ✅. Quote consent attached (doc id: AG-AP-2026). No additional restrictions other than attribution.
MarketplaceOps: Microcopy hard constraints: title 60 chars, description 140 chars, alt text 125 chars. Can you paste proposed strings? Also we need a 1-line tagline and a slightly longer blurb for the case study page.
Carmen (design): For alt text I propose: "ApolloCloud compact mark  inference platform for production LLMs" (but that  is a placeholder for em-dash? will use plain dash). Better: "ApolloCloud compact mark  managed GPU inference for production LLMs". (I'll refine once copy finalized.)
Ethan R: Let's keep copy tight. Two options:
```
short_title: ApolloCloud — Managed GPU inference (49 chars)
short_desc: Production-grade inference with 3x cost reduction for large language models. (96 chars)
long_blurb: ApolloCloud partnered with Redwood Inference to deploy production LLMs with improved latency and 3x cost savings through batching and KV caching. (162 chars)
```
Priya S: The short_desc looks good but drop the trailing punctuation. Also marketplace wants no percent signs in short desc? they allow numerals. OK.
Alex Chen (Apollo): Fine with that wording. Small tweak: change "3x" -> "threefold" for formal copy on the case study page; short marketplace copy can keep "3x".
LegalBot: Approved both numeric styles. No IP issues.
MarketplaceOps: We also need localized short_desc for FR and DE. Alex, can you confirm partner ok with translations?
Alex Chen (Apollo): Yes, translations OK. I'll have my PM share localized strings by EOD tomorrow.
Carmen (design): I'll produce the exports and a hero preview with the compact mark and dark CTA. Uploading to the shared folder now: https://files.redwood.com/apollo/exports.
Ethan R: Action checklist: 1) Carmen uploads SVG and PNGs to exports link; 2) Priya finalizes marketplace metadata using the short_title + short_desc; 3) Alex provides localized desc by EOD tomorrow; 4) LegalBot attaches signed consent (done); 5) MarketplaceOps schedules publish once assets + localized strings are in. Ping here when each item is done. :white_check_mark:
MarketplaceOps: I'll block Tuesday morning for publish and run accessibility checks on the CTA and alt text. Please ping me when assets are uploaded. :calendar:
